Remark
[Finite propagation speed for the porous medium equation] ↗ ex:porous-medium-scaling-invariant-barenblatt 1. ch4:4.2.2-rem-1\group Similarity Solutions

The Barenblatt profile has compact support at each $t>0$; degenerate diffusion therefore gives finite propagation speed for compactly supported nonnegative data.
